# Closed contexts and producer results

Owned generic instance methods retain a closed collection context, a fixed nominal context, one invariant producer and their original checked exception declaration. Frozen direct, compiled, reflection and MethodHandle callers compare receiver dispatch and reuse, callback order, nulls, opaque contexts and result identities, partial effects, exact exceptions and delayed casts. Source and SDK profiles compile every output and audit the original definitions, method roles, Signature and Exceptions. Only the owned program executes.
